definitions.gloss: vicious cycle; negative spiral; chain of negative events
definitions.explanation: A situation where one bad outcome leads to another, creating an ongoing cycle of negative consequences. Used in discussions of social problems, economics, and personal struggles.

examples.japanese: {負|ふ}の{連鎖|れんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}ち{切|き}る→断ち切る：15043_tachikiru⟧。
⟦{貧困|ひんこん}→貧困：04836_hinkon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{負|ふ}の{連鎖|れんさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: The vicious cycle of poverty has become a problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{睡眠|すいみん}{不足|ぶそく}→睡眠不足：08690_suiminbusoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{負|ふ}の{連鎖|れんさ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す→抜け出す：06040_nukedasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: It is not easy to escape the vicious cycle of sleep deprivation and stress.

notes:
USAGE:
Frequently appears in news, social commentary, and self-help contexts. Often used with verbs describing breaking or escaping the cycle.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {負|ふ}の{連鎖|れんさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}ち{切|き}る→断ち切る：15043_tachikiru⟧ (to break the vicious cycle)
- {負|ふ}の{連鎖|れんさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧ (to fall into a vicious cycle)
- {負|ふ}の{連鎖|れんさ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}け{出|だ}す→抜け出す：06040_nukedasu⟧ (to escape the negative spiral)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悪循環|あくじゅんかん}→悪循環：12668_akujunkan⟧: vicious circle — nearly synonymous, but more formal and academic in tone
